exposure: New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class I or II
cohort: 131 women with repaired congenital heart disease (CHD) who were NYHA Class I or II.
finding: Delivery was successful in most women with repaired CHD who were classified as NYHA Class I or II, although women with cyanotic CHD experienced higher rates of cesarean section and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were more common in the CyCHD than AcyCHD group, and CyCHD may be a potential risk for preterm deliveries.
